en: Fixed some Claude Desktop sessions on third-party providers, other than scheduled tasks, ending a turn with "Prompt is too long" when a PDF larger than the context window followed a long conversation
zh: 修复了第三方提供商上部分 Claude Desktop session（定时任务除外）在长对话之后跟随大于上下文窗口的 PDF 时，以 "Prompt is too long" 结束回合的问题
